hints: All array values are positive, so increasing the right edge only increases the window sum.
Grow the window until its sum reaches x; if it is too large, move the left edge forward.
Count each window with sum exactly x.
analogy: A positive-weight sliding window grows when light and shrinks when too heavy.
example: For 2,4,1,2,7 and x=7, matching windows are [2,4,1], [4,1,2], and [7], so answer 3.
algorithm: Use two pointers and running sum. Add each right value, shrink while sum>x, and add one when sum==x.
correctness: Positivity means a window that is too large can only be fixed by moving its left edge, and all candidate starts are visited in order.
complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
